title: Youth-Friendly Care: Rights, Respect, and Access

zones.label: Rights and Privacy
zones.summary: Youth-friendly care explains privacy, consent, records, and any limits clearly.
facts: Rules vary by age, service, location, and situation.
Ask the provider what is confidential before sharing.

zones.label: Culturally Safe Care
zones.summary: Respectful care makes room for identity, language, culture, family, and lived experience.
facts: Interpreters should support privacy and accuracy.
A patient can ask questions or seek a better fit.

zones.label: Sexual Health
zones.summary: Youth-friendly sexual healthcare is factual, nonjudgmental, inclusive, and private within applicable rules.
facts: Services may include testing, prevention, contraception, or counseling.

zones.label: Mental Health
zones.summary: Mental-health care can include screening, counseling, treatment, crisis support, and referrals.
facts: Care should explain choices and involve the young person.
Urgent safety concerns may limit confidentiality.

zones.label: Access Supports
zones.summary: Transportation, cost, hours, disability access, language, telehealth, and navigation affect access.
facts: A school or community navigator may help.
If one route fails, another support may exist.
